subject: perception work - data pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw you're working on perception & growing your research team. We've
onboarded robotics teams (Walden, AnyBotics & a few SF based humanoid
companies) around similar stages when they're scaling up real-world data
collection - thought this would be a good time to connect?

For context we help improve scalability of their annotation pipelines -
e.g. having system to index, auto-annotate and QA perception data across 2D
(image & video) and 3D point cloud/ LiDAR data in one place. With the goal
of accelerating their model iteration cycles & increasing labelling
throughput.

How are you thinking of your data requirements for the real world? I'm
flexible morning times EST if you're open to exchange perspectives.

subject: Encord & [COMPANY] - GTC follow-up
text:
Hi [NAME],

I stopped by [COMPANY]'s booth at GTC last week - really impressive to see
Polaris running across that many languages live.

I'm at Encord (Series C, ML DataOps platform) - given your background
spanning annotation, curation, QA, and evaluation, you're probably closer
to the data pipeline pain than anyone.

Scaling multilingual audio labelling across 40+ languages with the
consistency and quality control that foundation model training demands is a
serious operational challenge.

Encord helps teams like yours replace ad hoc annotation workflows with
structured pipelines, built-in QA, active learning to cut review volume,
and full inter-annotator agreement tracking.

Would you be up for a 25-minute call to compare notes on how you're
handling this today?

subject: Re: Hiring CV/Perception team members in San Jose
text:
[NAME] - given Imagry is building a full perception stack on vision alone
(no LiDAR crutch) the annotation and data curation burden on your team must
be enormous.

Woven by Toyota uses Encord to manage exactly that problem at scale:
embedding-based search to surface edge cases in driving video, plus
streamlined annotation pipelines that cut the manual overhead.

Given you're scaling deployments across Israel, Germany, Japan, and the US,
worth a call to see if we can take that off your teams plate?

subject: [NAME] - Audio AI
text:
Hi [NAME],

We just onboarded Neon on organizing and identifying valuable audio data collected by phone agents and thought it overlaps with what you're building at [COMPANY].

Encord works with Voice AI teams (Udio, Thinking Machines Lab) that build TTS/ASR/STS models and voice agents, supporting them on tasks like voice activity detection, diarization, word-level transcription, and model eval/preference ranking. 

Worth a 20-min chat to see if there's a fit on your side?

subject: Startup Innovation connection - Encord/[COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Seen your linkedin profile & experience and decided to get in touch.

I lead enterprise partnerships at Encord (YC company;100M series C), where
I work closely with innovation and technical teams supporting them to
explore how to move AI/ML use cases from idea to production.

A common challenge we see in large organisations is that multimodal data
(video, images, sensor data) is often siloed or difficult to operationalise
- which slows down promising AI initiatives. We support teams in
structuring and preparing this data to unlock use cases like computer
vision based automated inspection, anomaly detection, and robotics & more
<[LINK]>-
working with companies such as Boston Dynamics, AbbVie, or AXA.

I'd be really interested to hear what kinds of AI or data-driven
initiatives you're currently exploring at [COMPANY], and see if there's any
overlap where we could support.

Would you be open to connect with us next week?
